title: Communication Foundations
description: Build core spoken/written English from the ground up: introduce yourself, narrate, give opinions, argue, and handle questions. A2 to B2.

nodes.title: Introduce Yourself
nodes.skill: Frame a clear 2-sentence self-introduction (name, role, one detail).
nodes.teach_focus: Subject-verb basics in the present tense; one concrete detail.
nodes.success_criteria: Two grammatical sentences: who they are + one specific fact.
nodes.bridge_focus: Just one sentence: 'My name is ___ and I ___.'

nodes.title: Describe Your Routine
nodes.skill: Use the present simple to describe habitual actions in sequence.
nodes.teach_focus: Present-simple conjugation; sequencing words (first, then, after).
nodes.success_criteria: 3+ sequenced present-tense actions, correct verb forms.
nodes.bridge_focus: One present-tense sentence about a single daily action.

nodes.title: Narrate a Past Event
nodes.skill: Narrate a completed event using the past tense.
nodes.teach_focus: Regular vs irregular past forms; time markers (yesterday, last week).
nodes.success_criteria: A short past-tense narration with correct verb forms.

nodes.title: State an Opinion
nodes.skill: State an opinion with a supporting reason.
nodes.teach_focus: 'I think/believe ... because ...' framing; one clear reason.
nodes.success_criteria: An opinion + at least one relevant supporting reason.

nodes.title: Compare Two Things
nodes.skill: Compare two options using comparative structures.
nodes.success_criteria: A clear comparison naming a difference and a preference.
nodes.bridge_focus: One comparative sentence: 'A is ___er than B.'

nodes.title: Make a Short Argument
nodes.skill: Build a 3-part argument: claim, reason, example.
nodes.teach_focus: Claim -> reason -> concrete example structure; linking words.
nodes.success_criteria: A claim backed by a reason and a concrete example.
nodes.bridge_focus: State only the claim in one sentence; reasons come later.

nodes.title: Handle a Follow-up Question
nodes.skill: Answer an unexpected follow-up directly and concisely.
nodes.success_criteria: A direct, on-topic answer to the follow-up, no padding.
nodes.bridge_focus: Answer in a single sentence, then stop.

nodes.title: Speak Your Introduction
nodes.skill: Deliver the self-introduction aloud with clear pacing.
nodes.teach_focus: Pace and pausing; apply the text framing under voice.
nodes.success_criteria: Spoken intro, intelligible, steady pace, no long freezes.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say only your name and role aloud.

nodes.title: Hold a Short Exchange
nodes.skill: Sustain a short back-and-forth aloud without freezing.
nodes.teach_focus: Turn-taking; quick formulation under live pressure.
nodes.success_criteria: 3+ spoken turns staying on topic, recoverable hesitations.
nodes.bridge_focus: Answer one spoken question, then ask one back.

nodes.title: Recover Under Interruption
nodes.skill: Stay coherent when interrupted and regain the thread.
nodes.teach_focus: Reset phrases; finish the point after an interruption.
nodes.success_criteria: Handles an interruption and completes the original point.
nodes.bridge_focus: After an interruption, restate your last sentence.
